episodes.title: The New World
episodes.summary: Catherine of Aragon arrives in England to wed Prince Arthur, heir to the English throne, in a marriage contract intended to forge an alliance between the two nations.

episodes.title: Fever Dream
episodes.summary: Catherine is one step closer to the English throne with her marriage to Arthur but must navigate the challenges of a new relationship and a new court.

episodes.title: An Audacious Plan
episodes.summary: Catherine remains determined to become England's future Queen and makes plans to marry Prince Harry. Lizzie has a troubling premonition following a complicated labor.

episodes.title: The Battle for Harry
episodes.summary: As the nation mourns Lizzie's passing and Catherine works to secure her marriage to Harry, Henry shocks the family by announcing his intention to honor his wife's dying wish.

episodes.title: Heart Versus Duty
episodes.summary: Catherine is faced with a dilemma - marry King Henry Tudor and immediately become Queen of England - or find a way to refuse and hold out for Harry.

episodes.title: A Polite Kidnapping
episodes.summary: The English throne seems within Catherine's reach, but an unfortunate twist of fate means that her future now lies in the hands of her unstable older sister.

episodes.title: All is Lost
episodes.summary: The whole country is suffering - Catherine is barely recognizable as the 'Spanish Princess' and Maggie is destitute, but Catherine is determined not to abandon her destiny.

episodes.title: Destiny
episodes.summary: The fate of England hangs in the balance when the Tudor family is rocked by tragedy. Catherine risks everything to find out if Harry still loves her.

episodes.title: Camelot
episodes.summary: With a powerful alliance with Spain and an heir sleeping in his crib, what could go wrong for glamorous royal couple Catherine and Henry?

episodes.title: Flodden
episodes.summary: Henry invades France, leaving a pregnant Catherine to defend England from Scottish king, James IV. Let the Battle of Flodden commence…

episodes.title: Grief
episodes.summary: As Catherine fights to restore her marriage after another tragedy, so too Meg must find a way to pull Scotland together after the bloody battle of Flodden.

episodes.title: The Other Woman
episodes.summary: As Meg jeopardizes everything for love, a pregnant Catherine wrestles with the sickening suspicion that Henry is being unfaithful.

episodes.title: Plague
episodes.summary: When the plague hits London, the court flees to Hampton Court but Maggie and Thomas More remain in the empty – and surprisingly romantic - palace.

episodes.title: Field of Cloth of Gold
episodes.summary: A grand meeting in France forms the backdrop for a political clash of wits between Catherine and Wolsey – while back in London, rioting erupts.

episodes.title: Faith
episodes.summary: A new religion is on the rise, as is tension at court. Catherine must stop Henry's dangerous paranoia from turning friends into enemies...

episodes.title: Peace
episodes.summary: As Henry descends into madness, the stakes have never been higher for Catherine. Her husband has become a threat to her life.
